name: Basic Battlegrounds [GOKU BOSS + STARRK]
desc:
Fight in this universal anime battlegrounds game inspired by many other anime battlegrounds games. Supporting 📱Mobile📱 and 💻 Computer 💻 Controls: Front dash - Hold W + Q Block - F Side Dash/Ragdoll cancel - Q [W, A, S, D] Sprint - Double W - Please note that this game is still in a beta testing phase, expect bugs. 

GAME IS SUPPORTED FOR ALL PLATFORMS EXCEPT FOR VR HEADSET

💫 Please join the community below!
